data.long_meaning: Ekasha is a Sanskrit word that means unique or one. It is derived from the root word 'eka' which means one. This name is often given to a child who is believed to be unique or special in some way. The name Ekasha carries the meaning “Unique, One” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ekasha usually hope their child will grow to embody unique, one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_sanskrit.name: एकाशा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ekam Asi, meaning 'I am One', is a famous mantra in Hinduism. Ekasha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ekam' which means 'One'. The suffix '-asha' denotes the state or condition of being. So, Ekasha means 'The state or condition of being One' or 'The state of being Alone' or 'The Solitary State'.

in_hindi.name: एकाशा
